full_judgment: 2. Respondent Nos. 1-11 as the plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 180 of 2004 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, First Court, Gazipur for declaration of title and recovery of Khas possession in the suit land measuring an area of 01 decimal impleading petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 12 as defendant Nos. 1 and 2. Their case, in short, is that the suit land originally belonged to Amiruddin alias Aminuddin and Jamiruddin in equal shares and accordingly, the R.S. Khatian was prepared. The suit land described in the schedule to the plaint fell in the Saham of Aminuddin, who died leaving behind three sons, namely, Moslehuddin alias Moslemuddin Nurul Islam and Dalilur Rahman. The suit land was subsequently recorded in their names at the time of R.S. operation. Moslemuddin, Nurul Islam and Daliolur Rahman sold the suit land to the plaintiffs' predecessor-in-interest Serajuddin by a registered deed of sale dated 19.08.1974 and inducted the vendee into the possession of the land. After that, Serajuddin died leaving behind the plaintiffs as his heirs. Plaintiffs' further case is that the defendants forcibly dispossessed them from the suit land at the beginning of 1999 and erected a shop thereon. The plaintiffs requested the defendants several times to handover the vacant possession of the suit land but to no avail. Hence the plaintiffs were constrained to file the title suit. Defendant No. 2 contested the suit by filing a written statement denying all the material statements made in the plaint stating inter alia, that the plaintiffs' suit is not maintainable in its present form and it is bad for defect of parties.
